review.method: AI author self-review of full patterns and rendered group representatives: repair grammar and punctuation joins; label explicit recurrence words; include bare factual hard negatives; assign tags per form rather than copying group tags. Gold, discarded-clause, and split checks are automated, not human or independent-model review. Expanded interval/clock interactions and untimed selectors; controlled errors affect prose only and remain in their original source groups.
